text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.177 for the Senior Full Stack Software Developer position. The strongest evidence of their technical background includes "Built REST APIs", "React", and "Docker". Significant gaps exist, as the candidate is missing several must-have requirements including nodejs, ruby, sql, git, ci/cd, and cloud computing, and their 2.5 years of experience falls below the expected threshold. Despite the low fit and missing must-have skills, this application has been escalated for further review.
